targets.title: Human p38 MAP Kinase in Complex with Skepinone-L

primary_citation.title: Skepinone-L is a selective p38 mitogen-activated protein kinase inhibitor.

refinement.adp_decision: n_refl/n_atoms(non-H)=3.75 / d_min=2.7002: isotropic; TLS (d_min>=2.0 or chain>200 res)

caveats: The held-back report half, the unbiased estimate (PROTOCOL §3.6), improved much less than the full set. Ledger values, previous record (2026-08-28) → this model: full 0.25891 → 0.25246, report 0.26441 → 0.26334, select 0.25365 → 0.24205 (independent scorer: full 0.25968 → 0.25330, report 0.26517 → 0.26420). Most of the full-set gain sits on the select half, the half the search consults (D519).

This model is the graph search's third 3QUE promotion on 2026-10-03 (`3QUE.graph-weekend-20261002d`, generation 6). The one before it (generation 4, D520) had report 0.25983, better on both halves than the 2026-08-28 record; this promotion lowered full by 0.0004 and raised report by 0.0035. It passed the promotion rules (report inside 2σ_report of the record it replaced); no decision row covers it yet. The first promotion (generation 2, D518) had made report worse (0.26725).

The gain is water sites transferred from 9MHB, the 1.65 Å isomorphous p38α entry, combined in credited batches against matched null arms (D518, D520). Waters 15 → 46 against the previous release (deposited 14).

Rotamer outliers are above the campaign's 1.5 % cap: 4.29 % at release time (phenix.molprobity; previous released model 3.96 %, deposited 7.59 %). The campaign records 3.96 % for both records and calls it pre-existing (D518, D520).
The deposited header R-free (0.311) is a REFMAC number; Phenix recomputes the same model at 0.287 on these flags (D008). Only the recomputed value is comparable.

Most of the gain over the deposited file is Phenix re-refinement of a REFMAC-refined model (TLS, weight optimisation); the campaign's own credited changes are water edits: three added, two removed, water occupancies refined (D421/D485), then the 9MHB transfer waters.
The model carries no riding hydrogens: adding them was tested and rejected at 2.7 Å (D490).

targets.title: Crystal Structure of Engineered Protein. Northeast Structural Genomics Consortium Target OR62.

primary_citation.title: Exploration of alternate catalytic mechanisms and optimization strategies for retroaldolase design.

caveats: The held-back report half did not improve with the 2026-10-03 promotions: ledger 0.16726 → 0.16769 (independent scorer 0.16730 → 0.16772, +1.6σ_report, D519). The full-set gain 0.17276 → 0.17161 is carried by the select half (0.17815 → 0.17545), the half the search consults. Each promotion passed the promotion rules; D519 proposes a cumulative report bound that would have refused the second one.

Rotamer outliers 1.59 % at release time (campaign monitor 1.58 %) exceed the campaign's 1.5 % cap (D517); the previous released model had 0.8 %. Depositable by ordinary standards, not by the campaign's own bar.

What the 2026-10-03 promotions added: qFit alternate conformers at A175, A250 and A30 in a credited batch (`3TC7.graph-weekend-20261002c` generation 2, D517), then a second credited batch (generation 3, node N3.0, D519).

The largest single credited change on record is riding hydrogens on a model that never had any (no new parameters), −0.011 on every R-free set with the R-free − R-work gap unchanged (D488). Earlier credits added waters and alternate conformations.

The refinement protocol uses a fixed ADP weight (wxu_scale 0.03) because Phenix's weight optimiser widens the R-gap on the hydrogen-bearing model (D491/D496); a re-refinement with default weights will not reproduce the R-gap. The credit bar (σ_select) quoted below is from the noise floor re-measured under that protocol.

Campaign records after 2026-09-28 report a lower R-free on this target from manual Coot–refinement alternation (0.1583, D512). That model was never scored on the frozen flags and no copy of it was found (E039); plain Phenix water picking on these flags reaches 0.1702 and fails the R-gap gate. It is not in this release.

targets.title: Crystal structure of SARS-CoV-2 NSP3 macrodomain (C2 crystal form, 100 K)

primary_citation.title: Fragment binding to the Nsp3 macrodomain of SARS-CoV-2 identified through crystallographic screening and computational docking.

caveats: MolProbity rotamer outliers and the altloc-aware clashscore of this model exceed the campaign's own frozen caps (1.5 % and 5.0); the deposited multiconformer model already exceeds the clashscore cap by construction (D451, D474). Depositable by ordinary standards, not by the campaign's own bar.

The changes carried by this model are two waters removed plus three 15-macro-cycle refinement passes credited at 2.1σ, 2.0σ and 2.5σ (D489, D493, D494): continued refinement, not remodelling. The deposited model was already near-optimal as a single-conformer representation.

Three credited cycles on record (run `7KR0.exp_sw_distill`) belong to the ensemble-distillation line, which judged its candidates against its own base and was closed as a negative result (D463, D466); they are not in this model's lineage.

Ensemble representations of the same data score far lower (44PS, the six-conformation model of Passmore et al. 2026 on this dataset, 0.0657 on these flags; the campaign's own six-copy models 0.088–0.092). They are a second representation, not a deliverable (PROTOCOL §18.1); the campaign's are released separately in `representations/7KR0/`.

targets.title: 0.79A resolution structure of DMSO bound Cyclophilin D

primary_citation.title: Structure-based design of pyrazole derivatives targeting the human Cyclophilin D binding site

caveats: The released model is one Phenix re-refinement of the deposited file; nothing the agent proposed has been credited yet (E044). The −0.026 over the deposited file is the campaign's re-refinement protocol on its own, and it is mostly an ADP-model change: the deposited file carries ANISOU on 1 258 of its 1 597 non-hydrogen atoms (the isotropic ones are the 335 waters and the DMSO), the campaign's protocol refines every non-hydrogen atom anisotropically. R-work falls further than R-free, so the R-free − R-work gap widens from 0.011 to 0.014.
Rotamer outliers rise from 0.00 % to 0.73 % (one residue) and clashscore from 0.8 to 1.2 on re-refinement.

Nothing was credited on this target; the released model is the single Phenix re-refinement of the deposited file (D484). For CNS/REFMAC/X-PLOR-era depositions the campaign's noise floor measures convergence variance rather than test-set noise, so its credit bar was effectively unreachable (D506). The gain over the deposited file is what phenix.refine does on its own.

primary_citation.title: Immunization with lytic polysaccharide monooxygenase CbpD induces protective immunity against Pseudomonas aeruginosa pneumonia.

The released model is one Phenix re-refinement of the deposited file; nothing the agent proposed has been credited yet (E044). Rotamer outliers 2.3 % in both the deposited and the released model, above the campaign's 1.5 % cap (pre-existing).
The deposited model carries 665 hydrogens, an incomplete riding set; the released model keeps the deposited hydrogens.

Nothing was credited on this target; the released model is the single Phenix re-refinement of the deposited file (D484). For CNS/REFMAC/X-PLOR-era depositions the campaign's noise floor measures convergence variance rather than test-set noise, so its credit bar was effectively unreachable (D506). The gain over the deposited file is what phenix.refine does on its own.
